title: Pricing tunnel + HC trigger prototype
content:
Purpose:
Quick prototype for a pricing-tunnel construct that ties short-term pricing moves to headcount (HC) cadence and capacity hedges. This is a lightweight working sheet to capture thresholds, simple math, and candidate playbook actions for PM/Finance/SRE alignment.

Summary (one-liner):
If realized revenue per token drifts below tolerance OR unit cost drifts up beyond threshold, trigger a tiered HC and capacity response (soft freeze -> hiring pause -> redeploy contractors -> open reduction). Conversely, if price uplift or committed volume crosses commit bands, accelerate hiring and reserved capacity.

High-level assumptions (numbers are intentionally conservative for early testing):
- Baseline cost per 1M tokens served (mix model-mix, avg quantized): $18.40
- Baseline price per 1M tokens (list blended): $32.00
- Gross margin per 1M tokens: $13.60
- Monthly baseline throughput: 180M tokens (hosted + dedicated mix)
- Average FTE fully loaded (infra + SRE + eng compute ops): $220k/year (~$18.3k/mo)
- Contractor blended rate per FTE equivalent: $28k/mo

Sensitivity quick-matrix (price change -> HC action):
- Price drop -15% (list -> $27.20 per 1M): margin compresses to ~$8.80 per 1M; projected monthly margin loss: (32-27.2)/32 * baseline revenue ~ ~15% -> immediate action: soft hiring freeze on non-customer-facing reqs; delay hires for capacity-facing teams by 6 weeks.
- Price drop -30% (list -> $22.40 per 1M): margin ~ $4.00 per 1M; action: hiring freeze, reprioritize contractor conversions, pause non-essential tooling; open contingency hiring swap (replace 2 FTE hires with contractors for next 3 months).
- Price uplift +20%: accelerate hiring for capacity teams: add 3 FTEs across infra/ops over next quarter and scale Reserved GPUs (buy commit band 2).

HC trigger ladder (prototype thresholds):
- Soft Freeze: trigger when 3-month rolling margin falls by >=12% vs baseline OR a 10% QoQ revenue miss. Action: pause campus/recruiting pipeline, push noncritical offers to Q+1.
- Pause Hiring (capacity teams): trigger when 3-month margin falls >=20% OR price drop >=25% without commensurate volume uplift. Action: cancel 50% of open reqs for infra/infra-adjacent teams, reassign hiring budget to contractor pool.
- Redeploy Contractors: trigger when margin falls 30%+. Action: shift 20% of infra capacity to contractors; run contractor ramp plan (2 week onboarding).
- Accelerate Hiring: trigger when realized revenue runs 10% ahead AND committed volume forecast hits Band B (see capacity bands). Action: convert 50% of contractor pool to FTE and open 3 senior infra roles.

Mini budget table (quarter view, simplified):
Quarter | Baseline tokens (M/mo) | Price/1M | Revenue/mo | Variable cost/1M | Cost/mo | Margin/mo | FTE hiring plan
Q2 2026 | 180 | $32.00 | $5,760 | $18.40 | $3,312 | $2,448 | +1 infra, +1 sre (conditional)
Q3 2026 | 210 (projected) | $31.00 | $6,510 | $18.90 | $3,969 | $2,541 | +2 infra (if commit band B)
Q4 2026 | 240 | $30.50 | $7,320 | $19.20 | $4,608 | $2,712 | +3 infra (if uplift sustained)

Notes on math: Revenue/mo = tokens * price/1M. Cost/mo = tokens * cost/1M. Margin = revenue - cost. These are rough and ignore other fixed costs (product, sales, G&A).

Capacity bands (for Reserved GPU commits):
- Band A (baseline): 0-200M/mo -> no reserved add; use burst credits
- Band B (predictable growth): 200-300M/mo -> evaluate 3-month reserved commit (saves ~12% unit cost)
- Band C (scale): 300M+ -> 6-month reserved commit + auto-scaling pools; consider Dedicated lane expansion

Trigger examples (operationalized):
- Example 1: On 2026-03-28 monitoring shows 3mo rolling throughput +22% and price stable -> schedule recruitment slate: 3 org-approved reqs, open to market in 30 days.
- Example 2: On 2026-02-12 pricing tests (promo) reduce realized price by 18% with no volume uplift -> finance issues soft freeze memo to talent and requests immediate capacity re-eval.

Execution checklist (short):
- [ ] Wire up monthly margin telemetry to Alerts (owner: FP&A / twin dashboards).
- [ ] Add HC triggers as boolean gates in hiring tracker (owner: Talent Ops).
- [ ] Run 6-week contractor replacement playbook and pre-approved SOW templates (owner: Legal/Procurement).
- [ ] Simulation: run end-to-end pricing-tunnel sim in GitHub repo with random price shocks (owner: FinAnalytics).

Open questions / unresolved bits:
- How to treat multi-tenant dedicated customers with committed discounts? (need per-customer margin calc)
- Should we include a token-intensity coefficient per product (embeddings-heavy customers compress margin differently)?
- Can we automate gravitational fallback of low-priority workloads to spot/GPU-spot pools when margins slip? (ops question)

Immediate next steps (for the week):
- Ravi: prototype an automated alert (3mo rolling margin trigger) in Datadog/Looker. Target: 2026-04-09.
- Claire: map open req list and tag roles with "HC-triggered" boolean. Target: 2026-04-06.
- Sofia: prepare contractor SOW templates and quick vendor shortlist. Target: 2026-04-15.
